description_sq:
APARTAMENT 3+1+2 PER SHITJE KOMPLEKSI MAGNET
Ofrohet per Shitje Apartament Luksoz te Kompleksi Magnet prane 21 Dhjetorit.
Apartamenti eshte i arreduar ne detaje edhe ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar me te gjitha orendite e nevojshme.
Ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 133.2 m2 i organizuar ne nje sallon te bollshem se bashku me dhomen e gatimit, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkon.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone shume e preferuar per banim pasi eshte pjese e nje kompleksi rezidencial banimi gje qe te ofron te gjitha facilitete e nevojshme brenda kompleksit.
I dhene me qira 1200 euro ne muaj neto, kontrate 1 vjecare.
Apartamenti gjithashtu disponon edhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra.
description_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE MAGNET COMPLEX Luxurious Apartment in Magnet Complex is offered for sale near December 21. The apartment is furnished in detail and is offered fully furnished with all the necessary furniture. It has a total area of ​​133.2 m2 organized in a spacious living room together with the kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The area in which the apartment is located is a very preferred area for living as it is part of a residential residential complex that offers all the necessary facilities within the complex. Rented for 1200 euros per month net, 1 year contract. The apartment also has a parking space at an extra cost.
